basic_details.job_title: Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Yoga Trainer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One part-time Yoga Trainer (Yoga Prashikshak) is to be engaged at Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH), Pardi, Korpana taluka, under the National AYUSH Mission. The advertisement is issued by the Chairman, Selection Committee (AYUSH) and District Health Officer, Zilla Parishad (जिल्हा परिषद), Chandrapur. Applications must be submitted at the District AYUSH Cell, District Training Centre (Ward No. 60), District Surgeon's Office, District General Hospital, Chandrapur, and must be received by 17 November 2026, 4:00 PM. Applications received after that will not be accepted.

qualification.details: Qualification: The Yoga Trainer must hold a degree/diploma in yoga training from a university or institution that conducts yoga courses. The vacancy table gives the duration as minimum 1 year. Experience: The notice does not mention any required experience. The form records work experience, counting only government official experience in the total. Age limit: Not specified in the notification. Nature of post: Part-time Yoga Trainer (female/male), appointed on a purely temporary basis (class basis). Pay: Rs. 8000/- per month honorarium. The trainer must conduct yoga sessions of at least 32 hours per month at Rs. 250/- per hour. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The Yoga Trainer will be selected by the District-level Selection Committee after watching a direct practical demonstration by the candidate. The notice does not mention a written test.
important_instructions: Applications received after 17 November 2026, 4:00 PM will not be accepted. NHM is not responsible for late receipt or non-receipt of applications for any technical or other reason. An application not submitted by the due date and time will be treated as non-responsive. Candidature will be cancelled, without any reason given, if any information is found untrue, false or incorrect, or if the candidate does not meet the eligibility criteria. By signing the declaration, the candidate agrees to abide by the rules, regulations and procedures for appointment to the post.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates must submit their application at this address: District AYUSH Cell, District Training Centre (Ward No. 60), District Surgeon's Office, District General Hospital, Chandrapur Write the application on A4 size paper. The notice includes an application form (pages 3 and 4) issued by the National AYUSH Mission, District Integrated Health & Family Welfare Society, Chandrapur. Fill every field of the form. The form states that all fields are mandatory and an incomplete form will be treated as rejected. Attach the documents of your yoga qualification. Submit the application at the District AYUSH Cell address above so that it is received by 17 November 2026, 4:00 PM. The notice does not mention a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand); it only says the application is to be submitted at the above office. It prints no PIN code, email address or phone number. Name of the post applied for, full name, father's/husband's name, date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), gender, marital status, nationality, religion, category and applying category. Present and permanent address with state, PIN and contact number (district name and PIN code are compulsory), email ID and an alternate email ID if any. Computer proficiency and typing proficiency. Academic/professional education, starting from the most recent: period, degree/diploma, board/university/institute, specialisation/subjects, and final-year total marks, marks obtained and percentage. Work experience, starting from the current or most recent: period, organisation, designation and responsibilities (minimum 30 and maximum 50 words), with the total work experience in years and months (only government official experience). A signed declaration with place and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: The Yoga Trainer must hold a degree/diploma in yoga training from a university or institution that conducts yoga courses. The vacancy table gives the duration as minimum 1 year. Experience: The notice does not mention any required experience. The form records work experience, counting only government official experience in the total. Age limit: Not specified in the notification. Nature of post: Part-time Yoga Trainer (female/male), appointed on a purely temporary basis (class basis). Pay: Rs. 8000/- per month honorarium. The trainer must conduct yoga sessions of at least 32 hours per month at Rs. 250/- per hour. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct at least 32 yoga sessions of one hour each in a month, as per the schedule prepared by the Medical Officer of the AYUSH Arogya Vardhini Kendra. Of the 32 sessions, hold 20 at the AYUSH Arogya Vardhini Kendra and the remaining 12 in the field area (schools, ashram schools, colleges, gram panchayats, women's self-help groups, senior citizens' associations and other government/semi-government institutions). Train ASHAs, female health workers, male health workers and other staff in yoga and build their capacity. Help the Medical Officer, ASHAs and health workers organise awareness campaigns. Prepare yoga-related records regularly and help with the monthly report; help ASHAs and female health workers supervise yoga activities in the field. Organise at least two large-scale community-level yoga awareness campaigns in the field area in a year. Ensure that a large number of citizens attend the yoga sessions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents of the yoga training degree/diploma, attached to the application written on A4 paper.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Yoga Trainer will be selected by the District-level Selection Committee after watching a direct practical demonstration by the candidate. The notice does not mention a written test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Yoga Trainer post, at Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH), Pardi, under PHC Mandwa in Korpana taluka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Chandrapur Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 17 November 2026, up to 4:00 PM. Applications received later will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: A degree/diploma in yoga training (minimum 1 year) from a university or institution that conducts yoga courses.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Yoga Trainer?
faq.answer: The Yoga Trainer gets an honorarium of Rs. 8000/- per month, at Rs. 250/- per hour for at least 32 hours of yoga sessions per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Zilla Parishad Chandrapur Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: Write the application on A4 paper, attach your qualification documents and submit it at the District AYUSH Cell, District Training Centre (Ward No. 60), District Surgeon's Office, District General Hospital, Chandrapur.

faq.question: Q6. How will the Yoga Trainer be selected?
faq.answer: The District-level Selection Committee will select the Yoga Trainer after watching a direct practical demonstration by the candidate.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Yoga Trainer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is part-time and the appointment is on a purely temporary basis (class basis).

faq.question: Q8. How many yoga sessions must the Yoga Trainer conduct?
faq.answer: At least 32 one-hour sessions a month: 20 at the AYUSH Arogya Vardhini Kendra and 12 in the field area, plus at least two large community awareness campaigns a year.

faq.question: Q9. Can women apply for the Yoga Trainer post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice describes the post as Yoga Trainer (part-time) (female/male).
